title: Penicurvularins A and B, macrolides from an ascomycete fungus Alternaria sp.
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7830-7834
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09998F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Peinan Fu, Xi Ren, Qiaoling Wang, Feng Guo, Tingnan Zhou, Zhiyang Lv
Two new macrolides, penicurvularins A and B (1 and 2) were isolated from cultures of the ascomycete fungus Alternaria sp. Compound 1 is active against aquatic pathogenic bacteria.
